title: Inspect and extend: Map server-shaped data and manage channels/messages
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/chat.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve tochannels/tomessages, filtering, unread counts, optimistic append.
problem: External objects need validation before entering a UI list. Follow mapping functions and local helpers, then see how a sent message is appended optimistically. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/chat.ts` and the related project files: src/chat.ts; src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx; src/screens/ChannelsScreen.tsx.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to tochannels/tomessages, filtering, unread counts, optimistic append.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Method names and response shapes are a demo contract; confirm them against the target server version.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: External objects need validation before entering a UI list. Follow mapping functions and local helpers, then see how a sent message is appended optimistically.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/chat.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
